messages.text: Please create a PR, if possible add x-y view of the intersection with the surfaces. This can be done using the Propagation example wit step writing enabled.
I’ll add an x–y view using propagation step output, check it against the module surfaces, and open a PR with the assessment and plot.

The wheel has the propagation example machinery, but its ROOT step writer is unavailable. I’m checking the included OBJ step writer as an alternative; it should let us plot actual propagation steps without rebuilding ACTS.

Propagation with step logging now runs successfully through the mixed barrel/endcap geometry. I’ll plot a central x–y slice for zero field and a synthetic 2 T field, mark recorded steps on the module planes, and compare them with straight-line and circular reference intersections.

The x–y plot is ready: all 48 tracks were written in each field case, with 34 module intersections at zero field and 30 at 2 T. Every track’s intersections match the independent reference calculation. I’ll include the figure, reproduction commands and the ROOT-writer limitation in the PR.

The figure and numerical checks are complete. The PR will include both the original binding assessment and the propagation follow-up, with the prototype scope made explicit. Dashboard validation and the build pass; the regression suite is finishing before I publish.

[PR #14](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/14) is open with the x–y figure embedded, and review is requested from `asalzburger-review`. All 40 local tests passed. I’m recording the PR metadata in the project register; GitHub’s dashboard check is queued.

Created [PR #14](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/14), with review requested from `asalzburger-review`.

Includes x–y plots of actual propagation steps and module intersections at 0 T and 2 T. Used the available OBJ step writer because the wheel lacks ROOT support.

All 96 propagations and 40 local tests passed. GitHub CI is running. Tracker-layout work remains on hold.
